title: CMCD with Orange CDN and Hydrolix
description: Send CMCD data from Player to Orange CDN and query it through Hydrolix and Bitmovin Observability
long_description: Watch Bitmovin's Player attach standardised CMCD (Common Media Client Data, CTA-5004) telemetry to every manifest and segment request. Streams are delivered live from Orange CDN and CMCD-enriched request logs are streamed into Hydrolix, where they can be joined with Bitmovin Observability data through a shared session ID.
